codeReview.summary: Solid implementation of the validation contract system. The TypeBox schema correctly defines the contract structure with proper optional fields in the expect object. State manager's saveContract/loadContract follow the existing atomic-write pattern with proper error handling (separate catches for file-not-found, invalid JSON, and schema validation failures). The submit_plan extension correctly validates featureIds against plan features, rejects duplicate assertion IDs, forces status to 'pending', and handles contract creation/deletion on resubmission. Test coverage is thorough with 39 new tests across 3 files covering schema validation, state CRUD, and tool integration.

issues.description: The contractFilePath variable is constructed unconditionally but only used in the else branch (deletion path). Minor inefficiency — the join() call runs even when assertions are present and the variable is unused in that branch.

summary: Feature passes review. The validation contract system is well-implemented following existing codebase patterns. Schema definition, state persistence, and tool integration are all correct. The worker followed TDD procedure (tests first, then implementation), used atomic writes consistent with the state manager pattern, and all verification steps passed (2194 tests, tsc, biome). One non-blocking issue noted: a minor variable allocation inefficiency in submit-plan.ts. No shared state gaps observed — the worker used only documented commands and followed all conventions.
